blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Что это ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.)?
exercises.why: **несут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
